membership_extension: conditional continuation of mapped FIFA associations through current cutoff; not fresh independent membership certification
era_extension: 2025/2026 use latest 2020_2024 design column as declared 2020s carry-forward, not1980s zero baseline
uncertainty_scope: central90 latent-strength-implied probability range conditional on fitted coefficients and rating model; not confidence interval or coverage guarantee
issue_policy: both rounds issued together as of current cutoff; round6 preliminary, later actual-results update must be a new version
primary_target: binary home win vs draw/away for non-neutral venues
native_threeway: existing rating engine auxiliary WDL; distinct from joint binary model, no invented joint threeway conversion
displaced_hosts: geographical neutral proxy venue=0 in native auxiliary; joint binary withheld
